# Pololu U3V16F5 #4941 source set

Retrieved from Pololu for the perfboard review on 2026-09-04.

| File | Upstream source | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `pololu-product.html` | https://www.pololu.com/product/4941?print=1 | Product limits, connections, warnings, and graph links |
| `dimensions.pdf` | https://www.pololu.com/file/0J1921/step-up-voltage-regulator-u3v16fx-dimensions.pdf | Board, hole, and profile dimensions and tolerances |
| `max-current.png` | https://a.pololu-files.com/picture/0J11856.1200.png | Typical maximum continuous output-current graph |
| `pinout.jpg` | https://a.pololu-files.com/picture/0J11848.1200.jpg | Paired bottom/component-side pin identification |
| `top.jpg` | https://a.pololu-files.com/picture/0J11837.1200.jpg | U3V16F5 #4941 component-side photograph |
| `bottom.jpg` | https://a.pololu-files.com/picture/0J11843.1200.jpg | U3V16Fx bottom-side labels and orientation |

The dimension drawing and bottom photograph apply to the U3V16Fx family. The product page identifies #4941 as the fixed 5 V U3V16F5 and states that family variants look very similar, so identify the installed board before soldering.
